title: Critical window for approximate counting in dense Ising models
summary: We study the complexity of approximating the partition function of dense Ising models in the critical regime. Recent work of Chen, Chen, Yin, and Zhang (FOCS 2025) established fast mixing at criticality, and even beyond criticality in a window of width $N^{-1/2}$. We complement these algorithmic results by proving nearly tight hardness bounds, thus yielding the first instance of a sharp scaling window for the computational complexity of approximate counting.
